name: adapt-grow-carousel
summary: Carousel: one slide visible at a time, each with an optional image, title and caption; previous/next controls and indicator dots. Optional cycle and auto-scroll.

fill.note: The LESS reads --ab-* role tokens; grow-ab-bridge.less maps those onto the GROW scheme tokens, so controls and indicators follow the theme and dark mode. Note: the caption-overlay variant uses a deliberate black scrim gradient and #fff caption text (overlaid on photographs), which are intentionally fixed rather than theme-driven.
